## Prompt structure

A reproducible prompt names the limited job, context, verified inputs, criteria, restrictions, requested format and uncertainty rule.

> **Job:** critique, do not redesign. **Context:** desk name tag on a teacher-supplied 150 × 50 mm wood blank. **Criteria:** name readable at 2 m; 6 mm safe margin; original one-colour logo. **Restrictions:** engraving only; do not invent machine settings. **Output:** table of likely problems, evidence needed and one test for each. Label facts, assumptions and suggestions.

## Workflow record

Record the date, tool and model/version shown, exact prompt or accessible export, non-sensitive inputs, output identifier, sources opened, physical measurements, checks performed, decisions, and saved file versions. A person should be able to understand what happened without seeing a private chat.

Remove personal/confidential information before sharing. Test every submitted link in the same permission context the teacher will use.
